test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If an article is sold at a 6% profit instead of a 6% loss, the seller gets ₹60.72 more. Find the CP of the article?
solution:
**Given:**

If an article is sold at a 6% profit instead of a 6% loss, the seller gets ₹60.72 more.

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of the article be “x”

If sold at 6% profit

⇒ x + 0.06x = 1.06x

If sold at 6% loss

⇒ x – 0.06x = 0.94x

According to the question,

1.06x – 0.94x = 60.72

⇒ 0.12x = 60.72

⇒ x = 506

**∴ The CP of the article is ₹506.**
